{{Quote|Name's Gallia, foreman of this crew.|Gallia|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Gallia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] foreman of a Republic mining camp on [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She asked a fellow Republic citizen to wreak havoc with the Imperial forces threatening the camp.
